eps.ov: Fighter D encounters Chidori, a peculiar man investigating a string of mysterious disappearances.

eps.t: For This School, in This Moment
eps.ov: Fighter D and his squadmates encounter an enigmatic organization and are trapped in an illusion.
Fighter D and Hisui prepare for combat as the Green Squadron reunites with someone unexpected.

eps.t: Make Our Dreams Come True, Ranger Force
eps.ov: Fighter D turns the tide of the battle searching for a way back into the illusory school.

eps.t: The Arrival of Green ~The Maji Tsuyo Force~
eps.ov: Fighter D continues his search for the boss monster Magatia with Hisui and Nishiki, a detective.
Fighter D begins executing his plan to take down the Green Keeper with Suzukiri's help.

eps.t: We Are the Monster Protection Society
eps.ov: While the Ranger Force's deception is revealed, a new organization begins to lurk behind the scenes.
Fighter D and Hisui confront Yakushi Usukubo, the Head Director of the Monster Protection Society.
Fighter D learns the shocking truth behind the Divine Artifacts, Dragon Keepers, and monsters.
The thread of fate connecting Hibiki and Sesera begins unraveling towards an unexpected outcome.
As the world is under attack by the Monster Army, Fighter D renews his resolve once again.

eps.t: The One and Only Fighter D
eps.ov: Fighter D decides to cooperate with the Ranger Force temporarily to corner Deathmecia.
